slides.title: What about the other 150 people?
slides.brief:
Background: warm near-black — the color of a cabin at cruising altitude. Cozy. Contained. Something is happening and nobody told these people.
Top: bold white ALL-CAPS — "WHAT ABOUT THE OTHER" "150 PEOPLE?" Second line in hot pink. Below in white italic: "They booked a regular flight. They got the most irregular experience of their lives."
Main body: a large chaotic collage of real cabin moments — overlapping slightly, raw and candid, like someone grabbed screenshots from 12 different phones simultaneously:
Moment 1 (large, top-left): A middle-aged Pakistani man in a suit — clearly a businessman, laptop open on his tray — staring at the bowl of Bulgogi noodles that has just been placed in front of him. His expression: deeply confused. His laptop still open. He has not touched the noodles. He is processing.
Moment 2 (top-center): Two university-age girls in the seats next to each other — one is already filming the noodles, the other is texting at the speed of light. The text visible on her screen: "BAAJI THEY ARE SERVING KOREAN NOODLES ON THE PLANE I AM NOT JOKING"
Moment 3 (top-right): An older aunty — window seat, reading glasses on, a magazine in her lap — holding the Habanero Lime pack at arm's length and examining it with the focused expression of someone doing a very important inspection. She has not opened it yet. She is deciding.
Moment 4 (center-left): A young Pakistani man who has fully committed — bowl already half-eaten, phone propped up against the seat pocket filming himself, a thumbs up at camera, mouth full. He figured it out immediately.
Moment 5 (center): A family of four — parents and two kids. The kids have already torn open the packs. The mother is filming the father who is attempting to use chopsticks for the first time with the Bulgogi. The father is very confident. He should not be this confident.
Moment 6 (center-right): A businessman in 3B who has abandoned all pretense of working — laptop closed, earphones out, bowl of Carbonara in front of him, phone raised filming the cabin around him. He looks like a man who did not expect his Tuesday afternoon to go like this.
Moment 7 (bottom-left): A young woman who is clearly mid-TikTok — phone propped on her tray table, noodles in foreground, she's doing a voiceover. Caption visible: "POV you booked a Rs.8000 flight and got a gourmet experience 😭"
Moment 8 (bottom-right): An entire row — three strangers who didn't know each other an hour ago — now bonding over their bowls, comparing flavors, one passing their Gochujang to the other to try, complete strangers acting like old friends.
Top-right corner: a small bold callout box in hot pink — white text inside: "NONE OF THESE PEOPLE WERE BRIEFED. NONE OF THESE REACTIONS WERE DIRECTED."
Bottom strip full width dark green: white bold — "THE BEST CONTENT ON THIS FLIGHT WILL COME FROM SEAT 23B. AND NOBODY KNOWS WHO THAT IS YET."
